name: actor_1_safe_intersection_stop
description: Vehicle comes to a complete stop and yields correctly before proceeding.

name: actor_2_truck_merging
description: Truck merges into traffic without an adequate gap.

name: actor_3_failure_to_yield
description: Vehicle turns left across traffic without yielding to oncoming vehicles.

name: actor_4_bus_sudden_stop
description: Bus stops abruptly at an unmarked stop to pick up passengers.

name: actor_5_unsafe_overtake
description: Vehicle overtakes on a two-lane rural road with oncoming traffic.

name: actor_6_safe_following
description: Vehicle maintains a safe following distance.
